facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: lock out tag out failure on HT-9004

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control CONFINED_SPACE_ENTRY_PERMIT: the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STANDBY_ATTENDANCE_AND_RESCUE: the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit on HT-9004 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising and controlling entry, specifically standby attendance and entry logging. HT-9004 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 29 May 2014 an incident occurred on HT-9004 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during transfer operations, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
